rules.verified: Passport status VERIFIED from bin/proofforge check on the final candidate; for E1 runs, eval.json completed (judge ACCEPT and binary PASS on 2,000 property cases)
rules.verification: win when the ProofForge arm's verified fraction is higher, loss when lower
rules.cost: list $ per verified run (all list dollars of an arm divided by its verified runs); a difference under 5% is a tie; win when only ProofForge verified
rules.time: mean wall time of the verified runs, compared only when both arms verified; on E1 aggregates the mean on the paired tasks both arms verified; not compared on aggregates over several tasks with unpaired runs (muse-code-1 all four, hard-task-1 both tasks); a difference under 5% is a tie
rules.requirements: mean required theorems proved per run: the Passport count for a verified run, else the last compiling version where the run records it (last_compiling.json, ledger.json best_candidate), else the run's own check of its final snapshot
rules.cap_stops: fraction of runs stopped by the dollar or wall cap
rules.first_verified_s: A0, A1, A2: first accepted judge event in events.jsonl; Muse Code with ProofForge: end of the first check_candidate call returning VERIFIED; Muse Code alone: end of run, when the runner's judge accepted

notComparisons.why: Tactic portfolio replayed on recorded goals, no model calls: it closed 92 of 420 goals the model spent turns on (286 of 3,342 recorded turns, $6.31 of $63.65), none of them a required theorem. It measures a tool on recordings, not the model alone against the model with ProofForge.

Goal tool, refutation by sampling and parallel variants replayed on recordings, no model calls: the persistent session cut Lean time for 40 snippets from 205 s to 127 s; sampling refuted 0 of 374 introduced lemmas; variants were not shown to save dollars at list price. No model-alone arm.

Failure mining into ProofForgeFin and retrieval by goal shape, no model calls: 0 of 529 held-out open goals close only with the new library; goal-aware retrieval improves recall at 5 and 10 on every set. No model-alone arm.
Implement mode on the 30 test tasks, one arm (A1): 30 of 30 accepted. No model-alone arm in implement mode.
Implement mode on the real-world tasks, ProofForge arms only. No model-alone arm.
